verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents system snapshots, created automatically on every update and manually via `omarchy-snapshot create`, which give coarse system-level rollback. It also ships Lazygit, which a user could use to version and review config files. Neither is a dedicated mechanism for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations, and no doc describes such a workflow. Missing for 10: automation-specific version history, review/diff of automation changes, granular per-automation rollback, independent corroboration.
